sources.observations: Official text: each of three towers has a heated pool with cabanas and cocktail service. Official directions place pool1 beyond The Lounge/Starbucks, pool2 beyond Delights, pool3 beyond Fitness Center, each through glass doors.
Official PDF text: three pools with access links, three lobbies/porte-cocheres, three fire pits and walkway to MGM Grand. Visual review still required; web screenshot did not display.

Personally inspected: rectangular pool and separate foreground spa, stone paving, metal handrails, cream loungers, burgundy parasols, palms and rear cabana. Photo date unknown; which tower requires map alignment.
Personally inspected southern pool court: compact rectangle, west/south cabanas, paving grid and palms; old pool incorrectly placed farther northwest across retained drive.
Personally inspected middle pool: long rectangle, south separate spa, planted outer edges and cabanas. Old pool too far south behind mapped low structure.
Personally inspected north pool: rectangle with small south step projection, separate north spa, broad paved court and palms.
January2025 Street View personally inspected: west boundary masonry wall, palms above, monorail overhead. Pool not visible from street.
